verdict.rationale: Puzzle offers several background-automation features—custom categorization rules, AI Close, batch categorization, and 'described once, done automatically' workflows (puzzle-docs-5,6,7,17,18)—that run without manual triggering each time, fitting the 'autonomous background automation' story within the accounting domain. However, evidence is limited to marketing/help-doc descriptions with no independent hands-on verification of true autonomy, scheduling, or trigger-based workflows outside accounting tasks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of autonomous execution, details on scheduling/triggers, and evidence of general-purpose (non-accounting-specific) automation setup.
